name: dayflow
description: Ask about your day. Dayflow's timeline of what you worked on, read locally from your Mac.

interface.shortDescription: Your day's timeline, from the Dayflow Mac app.
interface.longDescription: Dayflow records what you work on and turns it into a timeline. This plugin lets you ask where your time went and draft standups and weekly reviews from it. Everything is read from the Dayflow app on this Mac; nothing is uploaded by the plugin.
defaultPrompt: @Dayflow what did I work on today?
@Dayflow where did my time go this week?
